ABOUT US

Gablewright is a venture-backed startup rethinking how new homes get from a floor plan to a finished street. Our design studio, configurator, and construction-document tools are used by residential builders across North America. We have raised $62M from firms and strategic investors across construction, building products, and real estate.



Gablewright is looking for a Director, UX Product Design to lead our growing design organization. Design is its own organization at Gablewright, reporting to the CPO, and this role owns all of it: the people, the practice, and the end-to-end experience of the product.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will inherit a team of five product designers and two researchers and be responsible for their growth, their work, and the health of the practice. Expect to:

 - Mentor, coach, and develop designers one-on-one - regular critique, honest growth feedback, and career paths that hold up.

 - Raise the bar on craft across the studio, workshop by workshop and review by review.

 - Tend the design system with the team that builds it and the teams that live in it.

 - Keep your own hands in the work: prototypes, system pieces, and design spikes alongside the team most weeks.

 - Own design's seat in product planning - design has budget, headcount, and a standing place in the roadmap conversation here, and you keep it that way.

 - Shape how the design org adopts AI in its ways of working, from AI-assisted drafting workflows to AI features in the configurator.

 - Stay with the product: we ship, learn, and refine release over release, and design leads that loop.


ABOUT YOU

You are a design leader who grows people and product at the same time, and you want one domain to hold for years rather than a new industry every engagement.

You have:

 - 7+ years of hands-on product design experience

 - 3+ years of design leadership experience: building, managing, and growing design teams

 - A portfolio that shows your judgment and how you simplify complex workflows

 - A record of developing designers - people you coached into bigger work

 - Comfort leading research and design together; our researchers report into this role

 - Clear, kind communication with your reports and with engineering and product partners

A plus if you bring:

 - A background in architecture, construction tech, or home design

 - Familiarity with 3D or parametric tools


WORKING AT GABLEWRIGHT

Gablewright has been remote-first since 2019. We keep the pace sustainable on purpose: flexible hours, an async-first culture, and a written work-life policy we actually follow. Compensation is competitive with meaningful equity.

We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, parental leave, disability coverage, and a 401(k). We also provide a stipend for your home office.

Please note: recruiting scams impersonating Gablewright have been reported. Genuine messages from our hiring team come only from an @gablewright.example email address.
